Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
XZealot wrote:
> Could I use Phagian's ability to allow Feo Ramos to play Trochomancy
> at the aus/nec level?

Yes. From the rulings page: An effect that allows a minion to play a card that
requires a Discipline he doesn't have (e.g., Infernal Familiar, Ian Forestal)
can be used to meet one (not both) of the normal Discipline requirements of a
multi-Discipline card.
